# 🤖 Gemini AI Setup Guide

Gemini is used to generate captions and hashtags for your videos.

## Quick Steps

### 1. Go to Google AI Studio

Open: [https://aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey)

### 2. Sign In

Use your Google account.

### 3. Create API Key

- Click **"Create API key"** button
- Select or create a Google Cloud project
- Copy the generated key (starts with `AIzaSy...`)

### 4. Add to Apollo

- Open Apollo
- Go to **Settings → Gemini AI**
- Paste your key in **API Keys** field
- Save settings

## Pro Tips

✅ **Add multiple keys** for automatic rotation on rate limits
✅ **Default model:** `gemini-2.0-flash-lite` (fast & cheap)
✅ **Browse models:** [https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models)

## Free Tier Limits

- 15 requests per minute
- 1500 requests per day
- More than enough for personal use
